title: Human vs. LMMs: Exploring the Discrepancy in Emoji Interpretation and Usage in Digital Communication

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing GPT-4V's semantic interpretations of emojis against human annotations using GloVe word embeddings and cosine distance. The study specifically evaluates discrepancies and misinterpretations in culturally specific emoji categories, such as 'Japanese symbols and objects'.

Assessing the impact of English-centric training corpora on the model's ability to interpret and generate emojis in social media contexts by comparing its emoji choices (using BERT embeddings and PCA visualization) against actual human usage.
